## Case or correction

- [ ] Original post, creator, and publication date are recorded.
- [ ] Model attribution and visible evidence are described accurately.
- [ ] Any prompt matches the creator's published text.
- [ ] All source media are accounted for, including shared footage.
- [ ] Curated data, menu, and all 11 READMEs agree.
- [ ] Media hosting and validation are recorded.
- [ ] Related links point to adjacent repositories. Changes to those repositories belong in separate pull requests.
